Hi Kajal, welcome!  It's great to meet you.  Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. I've reviewed your resume and am impressed with your projects, especially the inventory management system and the expense tracker. Your skills in Java, Python, and front-end technologies like React and Tailwind CSS are also very relevant to many of our open roles.

To get started, could you please tell me a little about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within computer science, and what you're hoping to achieve in your next role.
